description: What Cardmarket sellers ask for a card per language, finish and Cardmarket grade (MT Mint, NM, EX Excellent, GD Good, LP Light Played, PL Played, PO Poor): the cheapest visible offer and the median of the visible offers, in EUR, with the date the page was read. `coverage` says whether there is data: covered, no_offers, stale (older than 60 days, no figure) or not_covered (Pokemon EN/JP and One Piece singles from EUR 2 are covered, and German, Spanish and Italian copies of English Pokemon cards from EUR 5 Near Mint). `daily_lowest_near_mint` adds the cheapest Near Mint copy in German, Spanish and Italian from Cardmarket's daily figures. Cardmarket grades are not eBay conditions; `us_grade` is only a rough hint. Asking prices, not sales: use flipzi_get_sold_comps for what sold. Requires the ultra plan or higher. Cost: 1 unit.

card_id.description: Flipzi card id (UUID). Get it from flipzi_search_cards or flipzi_list_set_cards.

language.description: Only this Cardmarket language. Default: every language the card has.

seller_country.description: Only offers from sellers in these countries: ISO codes, comma-separated (e.g. "DE" or "DE,AT"), or "eu" for the 27 EU states. The answer then lists seller_country and per-language offers_matched. Default: sellers anywhere.

name: flipzi_get_cardmarket_conditions
